dispatch_evidence.findings_summary: MAJOR-1 (PROVEN, new in round 2, gate.sh:686 + :710 + :915-923): _gcia_analyze_segment replaces a balanced-$( token with the literal sentinel __GCIA_OPAQUE__; the separated `--author` branch (:710) then takes that sentinel as the author value, _gcia_unresolved does not match it (no $), a_email stays empty, and the unparseable-author fail-closed path blocks. Repro (throwaway + Circuit worktree, sandboxed ledger/cache): git commit --author "$(git log -1 --format=%an <%ae> abc123)" -m x -> rc=2, WHAT "sets identity via --author=__GCIA_OPAQUE__"; the FIX line (drop the override) does not describe the command. The glued form --author="$(...)" -> rc=0 with NO ledger warn (the opaque token is skipped before --author is ever seen), so note 4 / honest_status "a value only knowable at runtime is UNKNOWN: ledger warn, never blocked" is false in both directions for $(...). Corpus frequency: 0 hits for the separated shape in ~/.claude/projects outside this review session, so the live FP rate is ~0, but the diagnostic is wrong and no negative self-test pins the shape. Fix: in phase 2, when --author (or --author=) is followed by / holds an opaque or unresolved value, record it as UNKNOWN (ledger warn) instead of as the value; add a negative self-test for both the separated and glued $(...) forms and a positive one for a separated literal mismatch. Class: sentinel/placeholder values flowing into identity comparisons -- sweep every consumer of _GCIA_ARGS (--author, config set, init dir, add paths) for __GCIA_OPAQUE__ handling. MINOR-1 (PROVEN): records-only exemption over-accepts: `commit -i -- docs/reviews/records/a.json` with a non-record file staged -> rc=0 (git -i also commits the index), and `-- evil/docs/reviews/records/x.sh` -> rc=0 (the */docs/reviews/records/* arm matches any nested dir). HYPOTHESIZED siblings: --pathspec-from-file, -o. Impact limited to attributing non-record content to a synthetic reviewer+ identity. Fix: treat -i/--include/--pathspec-from-file as not-records-only and anchor the path to the repo-root records dir. MINOR-2: bash 3.2 not runnable here; grep found no bash-4-isms.
